features.name: outside-agent investigation profile and tool permission resilience
features.description: Outside subagents running non-interactively across claude-kiro, codex-kiro, agy, claude, and codex hit tool permission denials or unhandled halts during investigations and code reviews. Add an 'investigate' purpose profile with least-privilege network and tool access, expand agy review inspection commands, allow multi-candidate cascade fallback on candidate errors.
acceptance_criteria: outside-agent.sh run supports --purpose investigate with full inspection tools and network access
claude-kiro uses safe tool allowlisting without triggering classifier billing 402/hangs
codex-kiro and codex use danger-full-access for investigate and read-only for review
agy review allowlist supports find, which, stat, file, and 2>&1 redirections
candidate errors in a multi-candidate chain cascade to subsequent candidates instead of stopping immediately
unit tests verify all profiles, allowlist rules, and fallback cascades
features.evidence: Added '--purpose investigate' profile supporting unprompted network & inspection access; claude-kiro uses safe tool allowlisting for review ('Bash(git *),Bash(cat *),Bash(grep *),Read,Glob,Grep') and investigate ('Bash,Read,Glob,Grep') avoiding auto-mode 402 errors; codex-kiro uses '-s danger-full-access' for investigate and '-s read-only' for review; agy review allowlist expanded to include find, which, stat, file, and 2>&1; candidate tool denials cascade to subsequent candidates; secret-scan skips for review only (2026-11-05: the investigate skip was removed, since investigate can write). 213 unit tests passed, all 11 harness gates passed.
